info.title: Kaladel.Kiota.NullabilityFix.CSharp
info.description:
Post-processes Kiota-generated C# models so that properties marked as
            "required" (and non-nullable) in the source OpenAPI document are emitted as
            required/non-nullable C# properties, instead of Kiota's default of making
            every property nullable.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Tightens Kiota-generated C# model types to match 'required'/nullable information from the source OpenAPI document.

options.name: --openapi
options.description: Path to the OpenAPI document that was used to generate the Kiota C# client.

options.name: --kiota-output
options.description: Path to the directory Kiota generated the C# client into (the directory containing a 'Models' subfolder).
